property_summary: For any nonzero initial balance, a call to withdrawAll by the owner leaves the contract balance zero; the bug sends to msg.sender instead of _recipient, so the contract balance remains nonzero when _recipient != owner.
change_summary: Replace 'payable(_recipient).transfer(address(this).balance)' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance)' so funds are sent to caller instead of the provided parameter.
